(1) engine/trace_validator.py:176 validate_trace_markers(root, full=, changed_files=, scope=, cutoff=) with scan_trace_markers discovering ch:trace row= markers on .coding-hermes/board/{tasks,events}.jsonl, docs/*.md, specs/*.md and its own docstring; evidence grammar enforced (none:/commit-<hex>/history locator/verdict.json/existing repo-relative path). (2) engine/guard_manager.py:2386 _check_trace wired into run_all at :1970 behind self._enabled['trace'] (guard_manager.py:1711, default False = opt-in); this repo opts in via .gitreins/config.yaml:6 'trace: true'; engine/config_schema.py:116 adds trace KeySpec('bool'); engine/types.py:59 adds trace to _SUBSTANTIVE_STEPS. (3) Cutoff grandfathering: _check_trace supplies HEAD commit date (%cs) as cutoff in full-tree mode; _is_legacy_marker (trace_validator.py:131) grandfathers tasks.jsonl rows created before DOCTRINE_DATE 2026-10-11 and blame-dated lines <= cutoff. Verified: pytest tests/test_guard_manager.py -k TestGuardToggling -> 4 passed in 2.97s; pytest tests/test_guard_degraded.py -k 'toggling or disabled or noop' -> 1 passed; guard-log fixtures pin trace:false (tests/test_guard_log_persistence.py:89) and the full suite ran 3778 passed / 9 skipped with only the documented loadgen flake.
